$description: Spacing, radius, size and breakpoint values as shipped, copied from the style-guide artifact on 2026-11-03. Source data: do not edit.
source: MNG iOS Style Guide artifact (https://claude.ai/artifact/V364juyHFU3STfVZ6EgjMc), TroncKit @ f79fe3339, project/tokens.json

spacing.note: No shared spacing scale exists in the code. These are the values the code uses most, each with its source.

tokens.name: space-cell-margin
tokens.usage: Section-front cell margins on all four sides (SectionFrontCell.swift:46).

tokens.name: space-cell-padding
tokens.usage: Spacing between elements inside a section-front cell (SectionFrontCell.swift:47).

tokens.name: space-article-margin-min
tokens.usage: Minimum article side margin. The margin grows with width: 0.3125 x width - 160 (NativeArticleScrollView.swift:104).

tokens.name: space-article-top-phone
tokens.usage: Article card top margin on iPhone (ArticleCardCell.swift:30).

tokens.name: space-article-top-pad
tokens.usage: Article card top margin on iPad (ArticleCardCell.swift:30).

tokens.name: space-subscription-inset
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a subscription option button (SubscriptionOptionButton.xib).

tokens.name: space-sectionbar-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between section tabs, all markets (`sectionBarCellSpacing`). Half of it (7.5) pads each end.

tokens.name: space-header-band-inset
tokens.usage: Left and right text inset in the section header band.

tokens.name: space-savings-inset-phone
tokens.usage: Savings pill inset from the yearly option trailing edge on iPhone.

tokens.name: space-savings-inset-pad
tokens.usage: Savings pill inset from the yearly option trailing edge on iPad.

tokens.name: space-newsletters-icon-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label in Newsletters buttons.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Native Arc login only. Not shown in production: every market logs in through an Auth0 web view. Paywall Log In / Register buttons in the 70 standard-template markets (preferredButtonCornerRadius).

tokens.name: radius-button-legacy
tokens.usage: Paywall buttons in BS, DP, HC, MC, OS, SS, VP and TroncKit defaults; push-prompt Yes / No buttons (PushNotificationOptInView.xib).

tokens.name: radius-subscription
tokens.usage: Subscription option buttons (SubscriptionOptionButton.xib).

tokens.name: radius-google
tokens.usage: Sign in with Google button (TroncKit default). Native Arc login only. Not shown in production: every market logs in through an Auth0 web view.

tokens.name: radius-purchase
tokens.usage: Meter paywall purchase button and the Manage App Subscription / Cancel buttons (Paywall.storyboard, ManageSubscriptionViewController.swift:49).

tokens.name: radius-savings
tokens.usage: Savings pill on the subscription screen (SubscriptionOptionsViewController2.swift:165).

tokens.name: radius-newsletters
tokens.usage: Newsletters buttons, including Apple / Google sign-in (NewslettersUIConfigs.swift:65).

tokens.name: radius-hud
tokens.usage: Loading indicator card (LoadingIndicatorManager.swift:87).

tokens.name: size-touch-min
tokens.usage: Apple's minimum touch target. Not enforced app-wide; set by hand in about 6 places.

tokens.name: size-checkbox
tokens.usage: Your News topic checkbox, 30 x 30 (CollapsibleTableViewCell.swift:21). Below size-touch-min.

tokens.name: size-social-icon
tokens.usage: Icon inside social login buttons (SocialLoginButton.xib). Below size-touch-min. Native Arc login only. Not shown in production: every market logs in through an Auth0 web view.

tokens.name: size-tab-icon
tokens.usage: Font Awesome tab bar icons are drawn at 26 x 23 pt (CoreKit+FontAwesome.swift:16).

tokens.name: size-button-purchase
tokens.usage: Meter paywall purchase button, minimum height (Paywall.storyboard).

tokens.name: size-button-push
tokens.usage: Push prompt Yes and No buttons (PushNotificationOptInView.xib).

tokens.name: size-button-modal
tokens.usage: Manage App Subscription and Cancel buttons (ManageSubscriptionViewController.swift:129).

tokens.name: size-button-newsletters
tokens.usage: Newsletters buttons, minimum height (NewslettersUIConfigs.swift:64).

tokens.name: size-navbar
tokens.usage: Navigation bar. iOS default height; the app does not override it. The masthead logo shows at its natural size.

tokens.name: size-sectionbar
tokens.usage: Section tabs bar (LatestNews.storyboard).

tokens.name: size-section-underline
tokens.usage: Selected section tab underline, full tab width, fades in over 0.32 s (LatestNews.storyboard, SectionBarCell.swift).

tokens.name: size-banner-breaking
tokens.usage: Breaking-news banner (LatestNews.storyboard).

tokens.name: size-header-band

tokens.name: size-segment-band
